_comment: Deterministic file -> candidate AC table. Hand-authored from the real correspondence between app/ file responsibilities and the actual AC text in Kane's context graph (uc-1 only; uc-2/uc-3 not yet designed, so files that would map to them are intentionally left uncovered below rather than guessed).

rules.reason: Owns the persisted account plan read/write. ac-1 and ac-2 are both about the persisted value being correct on a fresh read.
Core business logic for upgrade/reset. Touches persistence (ac-1, ac-2), the direct-state-change/no-payment contract (ac-5), and is what reload-then-read (ac-6) ultimately depends on.
The upgrade endpoint itself. Drives the persisted-state change (ac-1) and is what the dashboard's upgrade button (ac-3) calls to produce the success confirmation (ac-4).
Serves the account read the dashboard uses on load/reload. Directly responsible for ac-2 (fresh fetch, not cached) and ac-6 (reload shows persisted Pro).
Frontend upgrade click handler and dashboard render logic. Responsible for the no-navigation upgrade trigger (ac-3), the in-view success confirmation (ac-4), and displaying the reloaded plan (ac-6).
Dashboard markup that the confirmation message and plan indicator render into.
Dev/testing utility only, explicitly out of scope in the PRD -- not covered by any AC.
Belongs to uc-2 (Access Advanced Reports), which has not been designed in Kane's context graph yet -- no live ACs exist for it. Flagged as uncovered rather than guessed.
